kind: SHA512 feed-forward AIR and actual single-block compression soundness
formal_claims: Eight constrained additions preserve the initial state across rows and bind each addend to the current round result.
Actual AIR satisfaction implies row79 output equals actual NearSpecV3.SHA512.compress of the decoded initial state and decoded block.
The decoded block has length128, parses to the initial sixteen-word window, and every decoded byte is below256.
limitations: Public initial state/message and endpoint output binding is not implemented.
Padding correctness, digest serialization, block chaining and universal full-trace witness completeness remain.
Rows80..127 execute zero-key rounds; endpoint is row79.
No full NEAR state-transition proof,1Pgas capacity measurement,sub-300KB proof,or128-bit quantum-security proof.

next_step_design.public_encoding: 128 field elements, each representing a16-bit limb; four little-endian limbs per64-bit word
next_step_design.binding_selectors: 96 first-row input bindings and32 phase79 output bindings
next_step_design.proof_obligation: Derive canonical limb ranges and public equality from actual AIR satisfaction; compose with compression_sound.
canonical_encoding_requirements: Require exactly128 public fields or equality to the canonical encoded public list; AIR Holds alone does not enforce list length and missing entries default to zero.
Use UInt64 inputs or explicit word bounds below2^64; conversion of unrestricted Nat into Fp is not injective.
Prove each public limb is below65536 from the constrained decomposition before using natural-number equality.
